title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers
tldr_zh: DiT 骨干不改参数，逐项切换连续时间/速度预测/Linear 插值/可调 w_t SDE 采样，ImageNet-256 FID 2.27→2.06、512 上 2.62
tldr_en: On an unchanged DiT backbone, switching to continuous time, velocity prediction, linear interpolant and tunable-diffusion SDE sampling lowers ImageNet-256 FID from 2.27 to 2.06 (2.62 at 512).
key_numbers: ImageNet-256 cfg=1.5: SiT-XL SDE FID 2.06 / sFID 4.49 / IS 277.50 vs DiT-XL 2.27 / 4.60 / 278.24 (Table 7)
ImageNet-512 cfg=1.5: SiT-XL SDE FID 2.62 vs DiT-XL 3.04 (Table 7)
SiT-B 400K ablation: DDPM 44.2 -> continuous 43.6 -> velocity 39.8 -> Linear 34.8 / GVP 34.6 -> SDE w^KL 33.6 / 32.9 (Tables 2-5)
Optimal diffusion coefficient w_t^KL = 2(sigma_t sigma_t' - alpha_t' sigma_t^2/alpha_t) minimizes SI KL bound; equals beta_t for VP (Eq. 13, Appendix A.5)
SDE beats ODE at 250 NFE for all sizes (e.g. SiT-XL 7M: 9.35 vs 8.26) while ODE is better at low NFE (Table 8, Fig. 5)
